## Service Details
### Screen Repair
Speedy iRepair replaces cracked and broken smartphone screens at our shop at 1650 W Market St in Akron, Ohio. We repair Apple, Samsung, LG, Google, Motorola, and OnePlus phones. Most screen repairs are completed the same day in 45 minutes, and every repair is covered by our 90-day warranty.
There is no upfront payment for iPhone repairs. Android repairs require a $20 deposit. If replacement parts need to be ordered, they arrive in 3-4 days from our warehouse.

### Battery Replacement
Speedy iRepair replaces worn-out smartphone batteries in Akron, Ohio. If your phone dies quickly or won't hold a charge, walk in to our 1650 W Market St shop or book online. iPhone repairs typically take 45-60 minutes, most Android repairs take 1-2 hours, and all repairs carry our 90-day warranty.

### Charger Port Repair
Speedy iRepair repairs damaged and loose smartphone charger ports in Akron, Ohio. If your phone won't charge or the cable won't stay connected, we can fix the port on Apple, Samsung, LG, Google, and other devices. iPhone repairs typically take 45-60 minutes, and every repair is backed by our 90-day warranty.

### Camera Repair
Speedy iRepair fixes broken smartphone cameras in Akron, Ohio, including blurry, cracked, or non-working front and rear cameras. We repair Apple, Samsung, LG, Google, and other devices at 1650 W Market St. iPhone repairs typically take 45-60 minutes, most Android repairs take 1-2 hours, and all repairs include our 90-day warranty.

### Water Damage Inspection
Speedy iRepair inspects water-damaged smartphones at our Akron, Ohio shop at 1650 W Market St. We can try to preserve your data, but we cannot guarantee full functionality after a water damage inspection. If we find damage that affects functionality beyond the repair, we will let you know before any work begins.
We recommend backing up your data via iCloud, Google, or other cloud services whenever you can.

### Device Unlocking
Speedy iRepair unlocks smartphones from any carrier at our shop at 1650 W Market St in Akron, Ohio. An unlocked phone can be used with a different carrier, including the Simple Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon prepaid plans we offer in store. Call 1.855.377.3339 or visit the store to get started.

### Certified Pre-Owned Devices
Speedy iRepair sells certified pre-owned Apple devices in Akron, Ohio, including tested and inspected iPhones, iPads, Apple Watch models, and MacBooks, plus accessories. Shop online or visit our store at 1650 W Market St. Financing is available through Acima with no credit needed, and phones not currently in stock require 50% down.

### Sell / Trade Your Device
Speedy iRepair buys and trades in used and broken smartphones in Akron, Ohio. We compare top trade-in prices so you get the best deal for your device. Get a quote, bring your device in or mail it, and get paid. We accept Apple, Samsung, LG, Google, Motorola, and OnePlus devices.

### Prepaid Phone Plans (Simple Mobile, AT&T, Verizon)
Speedy iRepair offers Simple Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon prepaid phone plans at our store at 1650 W Market St in Akron, Ohio. Prepaid plans help you save money every month. Visit the store or call 1.855.377.3339, and we will help you choose a plan and get your phone connected.

### Bill Payment Services (water, electric, gas)
Speedy iRepair offers bill payment services at our store at 1650 W Market St in Akron, Ohio. Pay your water, electric, and gas bills in person at our location, in the same visit as a phone repair, prepaid plan, or device purchase. Use Get Directions to find us on West Market Street.

### Home Internet ($40/mo, first month free, free phone with signup)
Speedy iRepair offers home internet in Akron, Ohio for $40 per month, with the first month free and a free smartphone when you sign up. It is a great fit for anyone moving into a new home, townhome, condo, or apartment. Sign up with our online form or visit our store at 1650 W Market St.

### Financing (Acima, no credit)
Speedy iRepair offers financing through Acima, a lease-to-own option with no credit needed. Use it to take home a smartphone, accessories, and more from our store at 1650 W Market St in Akron, Ohio. Select Apply Now to start your Acima application online, then shop with us in store or online.

### Accessories
Speedy iRepair sells smartphone accessories in Akron, Ohio, alongside certified pre-owned iPhones, iPads, Apple Watch models, and MacBooks. Browse accessories in our online shop or visit our store at 1650 W Market St. We accept all major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and Venmo, and Acima financing needs no credit.

### Replacement Parts (premium quality)
Speedy iRepair uses premium-quality replacement parts for every smartphone repair at our Akron, Ohio shop. All repairs are covered under our 90-day warranty; damage to your device after repair voids the warranty. Most repairs are done the same day in 45 minutes, and parts that need ordering arrive in 3-4 days.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How long does the average repair take?
A: iPhone repairs typically take 45-60 minutes. Most Android repairs take 1-2 hours, unless replacement parts need to be ordered (3-4 days from our warehouse).

Q: Do you offer a warranty on replacement parts?
A: All repairs are covered under our 90-day warranty. Damage to your device after repair voids the warranty.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: All major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and Venmo.

Q: Do you only repair screens?
A: No. We repair batteries, charger ports, cameras, speakers, and much more.

Q: Can you fix water-damaged devices?
A: We can try to preserve your data, but cannot guarantee full functionality after water damage inspection.

Q: Do I have to pay upfront?
A: No upfront payment for iPhone repairs. $20 deposit required on all Android repairs. 50% down on phone purchases not currently in stock.

Q: Will my phone look and function the same after repair?
A: Yes. If there is any damage that affects functionality beyond the repair, we will let you know beforehand.

Q: Will I lose my data during repair?
A: There is a small possibility. We recommend backing up your data via iCloud, Google, or other cloud services before bringing your device in.

## Shipping & Return Policy (Summary)
- Domestic shipping: most orders ship within 7-10 business days after payment is authorized and verified, via ePacket Mail (first class), with a tracking number emailed on shipment.
- International shipping: First Class Mail, 14-30 days. Tracking is not available for international orders; a customs number is provided. Customs fees and taxes are the customer's responsibility.
- Returns: accepted within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unused, in the same condition you received them, and in the original packaging. A receipt or proof of purchase is required.
- Non-returnable items: phone accessories, chargers, screen protectors, SIM cards, items with no serial number, gift cards, and downloadable software products.
- Refunds: after your return is received, inspected, and approved, the refund is credited to your original payment method within 3 business days.
- Sale items: only regular-priced items can be refunded; sale items cannot be refunded except electronic devices found to not work properly.
- Exchanges: we replace items only if they are defective or damaged. Email info@speedyirepair.com and mail the item to the ATTN: RMA Dept.
- Returned to sender: if an invalid address is provided, the Postal Service returns the package to us and we contact you to arrange re-shipment at your expense. Initial shipping costs are non-refundable for returned-to-sender packages.
Full policy: https://speedyirepair.com/policies/shipping-return

title: Shipping & Return Policy
subline: Shipping times, returns, refunds and exchanges for orders from Speedy iRepair.

children.text: SHIPPING | DOMESTIC

Orders are processed 7 days a week and most orders will ship within 7-10 business days after your payment is authorized and verified this doesn’t include weekends or holidays. All orders placed for delivery to the United States are shipped using ePacket Mail (first class) with a tracking number emailed to the customer upon shipment. Items noted as “PRE-ORDER” will ship upon arrival from the manufacturer or date provided in the item description. If there is a delay in ability to ship the order you will be contacted via email. We are not responsible for any packages lost, stolen or delayed by the postal service.
Returns
Our policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have gone by since your purchase, unfortunately we can’t offer you a refund or exchange.
To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.
Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Phone accessories, chargers, screen protectors, SIM cards and items with no serial number cannot be returned.

Additional non-returnable items:
Gift cards
Downloadable software products
To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.
Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted (if applicable)
Devices with obvious signs of use or damage.
Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED FOR RETURNS!
Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED FOR RETURNS!
Refunds (if applicable)

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.
If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a 3 business days.
Late or missing refunds (if applicable)

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.
Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.
Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.
If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at info@speedyirepair.com.
Sale items (if applicable)

children.text: This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit or make a purchase from speedyirepair.com (the “Site”).
PERSONAL INFORMATION WE COLLECT

When you visit the Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including information about your web browser, IP address, time zone, and some of the cookies that are installed on your device. Additionally, as you browse the Site, we collect information about the individual web pages or products that you view, what websites or search terms referred you to the Site, and information about how you interact with the Site. We refer to this automatically-collected information as “Device Information”.

We collect Device Information using the following technologies:
- “Cookies” are data files that are placed on your device or computer and often include an anonymous unique identifier. For more information about cookies, and how to disable cookies, visit http://www.allaboutcookies.org.
- “Log files” track actions occurring on the Site, and collect data including your IP address, browser type, Internet service provider, referring/exit pages, and date/time stamps.
- “Web beacons”, “tags”, and “pixels” are electronic files used to record information about how you browse the Site.

Additionally when you make a purchase or attempt to make a purchase through the Site, we collect certain information from you, including your name, billing address, shipping address, payment information (including credit card numbers, email address, and phone number. We refer to this information as “Order Information”.
When we talk about “Personal Information” in this Privacy Policy, we are talking both about Device Information and Order Information.
HOW DO WE USE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION?

We use the Order Information that we collect generally to fulfill any orders placed through the Site (including processing your payment information, arranging for shipping, and providing you with invoices and/or order confirmations). Additionally, we use this Order Information to:
- Communicate with you;
- Screen our orders for potential risk or fraud; and
- When in line with the preferences you have shared with us, provide you with information or advertising relating to our products or services.

We use the Device Information that we collect to help us screen for potential risk and fraud (in particular, your IP address), and more generally to improve and optimize our Site (for example, by generating analytics about how our customers browse and interact with the Site, and to assess the success of our marketing and advertising campaigns).
SHARING YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION

We share your Personal Information with third parties to help us use your Personal Information, as described above. For example, we use Shopify to power our online store--you can read more about how Shopify uses your Personal Information here: https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy. We also use Google Analytics to help us understand how our customers use the Site -- you can read more about how Google uses your Personal Information here: https://www.google.com/intl/en/policies/privacy/. You can also opt-out of Google Analytics here: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

Finally, we may also share your Personal Information to comply with applicable laws and regulations, to respond to a subpoena, search warrant or other lawful request for information we receive, or to otherwise protect our rights.
BEHAVIOURAL ADVERTISING

As described above, we use your Personal Information to provide you with targeted advertisements or marketing communications we believe may be of interest to you. For more information about how targeted advertising works, you can visit the Network Advertising Initiative’s (“NAI”) educational page at http://www.networkadvertising.org/understanding-online-advertising/how-does-it-work.

You can opt out of targeted advertising by using the links below:
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/settings/?tab=ads
- Google: https://www.google.com/settings/ads/anonymous
- Bing: https://advertise.bingads.microsoft.com/en-us/resources/policies/personalized-ads
Additionally, you can opt out of some of these services by visiting the Digital Advertising Alliance’s opt-out portal at: http://optout.aboutads.info/.
DO NOT TRACK
Please note that we do not alter our Site’s data collection and use practices when we see a Do Not Track signal from your browser.
YOUR RIGHTS

If you are a European resident, you have the right to access personal information we hold about you and to ask that your personal information be corrected, updated, or deleted. If you would like to exercise this right, please contact us through the contact information below.

Additionally, if you are a European resident we note that we are processing your information in order to fulfill contracts we might have with you (for example if you make an order through the Site), or otherwise to pursue our legitimate business interests listed above. Additionally, please note that your information will be transferred outside of Europe, including to Canada and the United States.
DATA RETENTION
When you place an order through the Site, we will maintain your Order Information for our records unless and until you ask us to delete this information.
CHANGES
We may update this privacy policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to our practices or for other operational, legal or regulatory reasons.
